name: How long does a typical bathroom countertop replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom countertop replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom countertop replacement project typically takes 1 to 3 days from demolition to installation, assuming the cabinet base remains. This timeline can vary depending on the material chosen, the complexity of the design, and any necessary plumbing adjustments for a new sink or faucet. Custom fabrication, such as for natural stone, can add several weeks to the overall project timeline before installation can begin.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom countertop replacement takes 1-3 days for installation, though custom fabrication can extend the overall project timeline.
